decisions.reason: The piqué upholstery fabric sits squarely within the firm's core upholstery know-how and had a page of its own, so the firm can read its market response and refine it through in-house development rather than drop it.

The semi-transparent bouclé builds on established decoration expertise, but its low website prominence and the typical two-to-three-year collection rotation that already removed C and D make pruning a real risk, though not yet the likely outcome.

The wool bouclé leno combines the firm's sheer-fabric and wool knowledge and fits its shift toward renewable materials, so the firm can absorb customer feedback and improve it, despite some rotation risk from its low prominence.
The braided-structure fabric is a recent launch with a page of its own that builds on existing upholstery and curtain competence, and the firm needs more market feedback before it can judge it.
